question: Which chapter and topic are concluded in the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra here?
premises: The topic is the exposition of the peacock feather
inference: This marks the eighth chapter, the exposition of the peacock feather, in the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
plain_english: This is the eighth chapter, the exposition of the peacock feather, in the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
